title: SHD Build Intelligence
subtitle: Division 2 Armory, 6-Slot Workbench & Expertise 413/500 Tracker
description: 100% EAC-Safe Division 2 Build Solver, Interactive 6-Slot Theorycraft Workbench with Admin Showcase Loadouts ('Lengmo Pesti Turm'), Countdown Target Loot Radar, and Expertise 413/500 Mastery Tracker with per-user Google Auth isolation.
tagline: 100% EAC-Safe Division 2 Armory, 6-Slot Theorycraft Workbench, Build Solver & Expertise 413/500 Tracker

quickstart.step: Load Your Armory Seed or Import Snapshot (`⚙️ PC Sync / Vault`)
quickstart.detail: Open SHD Build Intelligence and tap `⚙️ PC Sync / Vault` (or the top Sync button) to pull your PC Armory seed or import a saved `.json` gear dump into your isolated Google user profile.

quickstart.step: Filter & Inspect Rolled Gear in the Armory
quickstart.detail: Search weapons, exotics, named items, brand sets, and gear sets—tap any item row for Click-to-Verify roll percentages, core attributes, talents, and recalibration potential.
Equip Mask, Backpack, Chest, Gloves, Holster, and Kneepads (or clone an Admin Showcase Loadout like `Lengmo Pesti Turm`) to see live brand bonuses, CHC/CHD caps, and synergy diagnostics.
Check the Countdown Target Loot Radar to see which brand/slot to farm next, and log proficiency ranks in the Expertise Mastery Tracker.

navigation_map.purpose: Searchable, filterable gear & weapon database with God-roll badges and Click-to-Verify attribute breakdown modals.
Interactive loadout assembler with Admin Showcase templates, live brand-set bonus counters, and stat rollups.
100% EAC-safe deterministic solver matching your owned stash items against target DPS/Skill/Tank archetypes and Countdown farm priorities.
Category-by-category proficiency checklist toward max Expertise (`413/500+`) saved per user.
1-tap JSON backup export/import and PC-to-Android cartridge synchronization.

deep_dive_features.title: 100% Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) Safe Architecture
deep_dive_features.body: Operates strictly on exported OCR/JSON inventory snapshots—zero game memory hooks, zero packet inspection, and full offline mobile theorycrafting anywhere.

deep_dive_features.title: Cloneable Admin Showcase Loadouts
deep_dive_features.body: Friends/clanmates authorized on RollupOS can inspect read-only Admin Showcase builds (`Lengmo Pesti Turm`, Striker setups, etc.) and clone them into their own private Workbench without overwriting your stash.

pro_tips: Before deconstructing stash clutter in-game, filter the Build Solver to verify an item isn't a unicorn off-brand roll needed for a hybrid chest/backpack slot.
Export a `.json` backup snapshot after major Countdown farming sessions so your PC and phone stay in lockstep.
